data_quality.premium_source: Rounded human-readable premium column normalized to numeric USD (precision approximately $1K per print).
caveats: Cash VIX spot sampled from tape, not an independent synchronized close.
VIX moneyness assessed against expiry-specific forward from synchronous same-strike call/put mid; unresolved expiry forwards remain null.
Five rows have unknown aggressor; raw signed delta kept as reported and unknown sides excluded from known-side net premium.
Current OI profile confirms prior Friday Sep25 flows, not Sep28 opening/closing.
Some profile volume materially exceeds $50k filtered tape volume, hence missing-side transactions cannot be reconstructed.
Trade and complex order IDs absent; timestamp/ratio multileg matches are hypotheses.
Raw timestamp contains inconsistent 2026-09-29 ISO date prefix and 09-28 trade-day suffix; economic session assigned using the suffix.
No dealer inventory, full market position, or deterministic SPX forecast inferred.
